label: 214-cv-001b-marker-fix
rootCause: Two compounding failures: (1) CustomerValueClassificationService.loadClassificationSummaries used `.select()` on xero_customer_mappings, which referenced undeployed conflict_metadata on staging (PG 42703) — refreshValueMetrics threw before markCustomerValueMetricsRefreshed could run; staging logs confirmed this. (2) Connector autoSync patches used read-modify-write without preserving cvMetricsRefreshJobId, so outcome-meta updates could clobber the marker when refresh did succeed.

changes: Narrow xeroCustomerMappings select to customerId + xeroContactId only (same staging schema-drift pattern as payments hotfix).
Added mergeAutoSyncState + patchConnectorAutoSync to preserve cvMetricsRefreshJobId/cvMetricsRefreshAt across connector config updates.
Reordered handleXeroImportJobSettled: CV refresh + mark before integration outcome meta patch.
Wrapped CV refresh failures in try/catch; scheduler fallback logs and retries.
Added unit tests for call order, marker preservation, and narrow mapping select.

verification214.note: Post-deploy scheduled import 93144ea8 running (contacts) blocks refreshPendingCustomerValueMetrics backfill for completed job 8e6aec9b. No conflict_metadata errors in logs after 529d27f deploy.
verification214.expectPassAfter: Import 93144ea8 completes (handleXeroImportJobSettled) or quiescence + scheduler tick backfills 8e6aec9b/93144ea8

gate187Expectation.afterQuiescence: PASS expected — cv_auto_recalc_fired should set cvMetricsRefreshJobId on next successful import settle or scheduler backfill
